name: nw_sabah_surfaces
title: NW Sabah published surface ages (Morley et al. 2023)
citation: Morley, C.K., et al. (2023), Geosphere, v.19, no.1, https://doi.org/10.1130/GES02518.1
description: Published ages of regional surfaces in NW Sabah (North Block H reference section). Ages are ranges from the paper; depth ranges are typical but vary by line. PUBLIC-REFERENCE only — no well- or line-specific picks. Drives geox_seismic_age_assign.v1.

DRU.label: Deep Regional Unconformity
DRU.semantic: Base of mini-basin deposition; pre-NSPW mobile-shale detachment
DRU.morphology: Single surface; not folded; underlies all mini-basins
DRU.thickness_max_ivc_source: Morley 2023 §6.2, fig.16 — IVC thickness max ~0.4 s TWT

LIU.label: Lower Intra-IVC Unconformity
LIU.semantic: Mid-IVC intra-stage boundary; separates lower IVC from upper mud-canopy phase
LIU.morphology: Subtle; often below resolution of regional lines; visible only on PSDM

UIU.label: Upper Intra-IVC Unconformity
UIU.semantic: Top of mini-basin fill; base of IVC mud-canopy basin; thrusting ends mini-basin phase
UIU.morphology: Onlapping relationship to mobile-shale highs; truncates older reflectors near diapir crests

SRU.label: Shallow Regional Unconformity
SRU.semantic: Top of IVC mud-canopy basin; pre-Stage IVD drape

H-III.label: Horizon III (intra-IVD)
H-III.semantic: Intra-IVD marker; younger than SRU; useful for post-canopy drape geometry
H-III.morphology: Continuous regional reflector; often bright red on Morley figures

TOP_IVC.label: Top IVC
TOP_IVC.semantic: Top of mud-canopy basin; base of post-canopy drape sequence (IVD–IVG)
TOP_IVC.morphology: Often merged with SRU where compaction is high

notes: REFERENCE-only resource. Ages are ranges from the published paper; thickness_max are typical (TWT ms) and vary by line. Use geox_seismic_age_assign.v1 with a thickness plausibility gate — exceeding thickness_max_ivc_ms returns HOLD, not a forced assignment.
